question: What are common symptoms of depression?
answer: Common symptoms of depression include ongoing sadness or emptiness, irritability, changes in appetite or weight, sleep disturbance, fatigue, and difficulty concentrating, present most of the day nearly every day. [medlineplus-depression-2][who-depression-2] Around 5% of adults worldwide live with depression at any given time, and more women are affected than men. [who-depression-1] Major depressive disorder involves severe symptoms that interfere with daily life. [nimh-depression-1]
